dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: I wonder — what sorts of clothes are in fashion over in the city of Fontaine? Hmm? Are you wearing the latest and greatest, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I—I doubt so...

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Huh. I do think that the clothes you're wearing do have a designer feel to them, though...

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: I've never seen their like before. In fact, I thought that they were some new fashion of a sort... Ah, I'd love to try something like that on.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Sure. Please tell me about any beautiful clothes you know of next time we meet, alright?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You love fashionable outfits, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Sure do!

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Lovely clothes with their own sense of style can sometimes even give their wearers confidence in their beauty. It's a wonderful thing.

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: People who are able to design such clothes are awesome. I, too, really love sewing and design work.

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Sometimes, when I see the beautiful clothes worn by people in the city of Fontaine, I think, "Ah, if only I could put something similar on!"

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can Melusines wear human clothes, though...

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Well, of course not. Our bodies are very different — even beautiful clothes made for children wouldn't make good direct fits for us...

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: But whether we be human or Melusine, our feelings toward lovely clothes are one and the same, and so I wish to create such clothes that Melusines, too, can wear!

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Ah, I heard about what happened from Virda. Thank you for saving her!

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Sorry for the trouble my little sister caused you. I'll remind her to stay safe in the future...

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Oh dear. How could I ever thank you? ... Oh, I know! Why don't I help you design a set of clothes?

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Really, though, I'm only any good at sewing... So how would tights do? I've heard that the thieves and heroes in those stories all love wearing them...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think I'll pass on the tights...

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Ah, so you don't like them? Well, if you find clothes that you do like, please, tell me.

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: I can imitate even the most fashionable outfits perfectly as long as I have something to model my work after. I'm quite confident in my work in this regard!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me about Virda...

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: She's not injured — thanks to you, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: She seems to have gotten all excited about having been able to help out, though. *sigh* I have to wonder if she heard a word I said about staying safe...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you...

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Alright. Next time we meet, if you want any nice-looking clothes, you can come to me to get its design worked out...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the earthquake just a while ago...

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Hmm. Was it just me, or was everything shaking a bit just now?

dialogues.speaker: Flo
dialogues.text: Oh dear... Virda said that she'd be going out to train. Will she be alright?
